nodes.mechanism: Wireless commands provide setpoints while multiple heater-sensor modules return measurements and independently adjust output.

nodes.label: Wireless Implantable Optogenetic Stimulation
nodes.description: Use a wirelessly powered implanted microscale LED to deliver targeted optical stimulation to opsin-expressing neural tissue.
nodes.function: Provide programmable neural stimulation in freely moving or chronically implanted subjects.
nodes.mechanism: An external RF field powers and controls a flexible coil-connected m-ILED positioned at a selected neural target.

nodes.label: Wireless Implanted Optical Emitter
nodes.description: Use remotely powered implanted emitters to deliver programmable optical stimulation without a wired tether.
nodes.function: Provide localized or distributed optogenetic stimulation in freely moving subjects.
nodes.mechanism: RF or inductive power and control drive implanted LEDs or LED arrays positioned near opsin-expressing tissue.

nodes.label: Wireless Multimodal Epidermal Platform
nodes.description: Integrate multiple sensing, power, and wireless communication functions into a conformal epidermal platform.
nodes.function: Acquire and transmit distributed physiological or environmental measurements.
nodes.mechanism: Compliant skin interfaces combine heterogeneous sensors with power harvesting, NFC or wireless communication, and shared readout electronics.

nodes.label: Wireless Multimodal Mechano-Acoustic Platforms
nodes.description: Deploy inertial or vibration sensing with local processing and wireless telemetry for untethered multimodal physiological and behavioral monitoring.
nodes.function: Acquire and transmit complementary mechanical observables during free movement.
nodes.mechanism: Body-coupled accelerometers or IMUs and broadband vibration sensors feed onboard conditioning, storage, classification, and wireless communication.

nodes.label: Wireless Multimodal Neonatal Monitoring
nodes.description: Combine wireless skin-interfaced modalities for continuous neonatal vital-sign and physiological monitoring.
nodes.function: Provide comprehensive neonatal monitoring without cumbersome wired connections.
nodes.mechanism: Multiple electrical, optical, mechanical, thermal, and behavioral sensors acquire complementary signals and stream them to clinical or mobile analytics systems.

nodes.label: Wireless Multinode Time-Coordinated Sensing
nodes.description: Coordinate multiple wireless sensor nodes on a shared timeline for distributed multimodal or multisite measurement.
nodes.function: Enable synchronized acquisition and spatiotemporal comparison across several sensing locations.
nodes.mechanism: Wireless network coordination links node timing with distributed physiological, acoustic, motion, or other measurements for joint analysis.
design_handles: Number and placement of sensor sites

nodes.label: Wireless NFC Multichannel Control
nodes.description: Use NFC or RF commands with embedded memory and firmware to update and execute independently addressable implanted stimulation channels.
nodes.function: Provide tether-free, user-programmable multichannel implant control.
nodes.mechanism: A near-field wireless link writes channel, sequence, timing, and pulse parameters to local memory; a microcontroller interprets them and drives selected outputs.
failure_modes: Limited operating area or field nonuniformity

nodes.label: Wireless Optical-Electrochemical Fluidic Interface
nodes.description: Combine wireless optical stimulation with independently addressable electrochemical or RF-powered fluidic delivery channels in a soft implant.
nodes.function: Provide coordinated or independent optical and multi-agent pharmacological intervention.
nodes.mechanism: Wireless power and control operate μ-LEDs and electrochemical or thermally actuated pumps connected to separate microfluidic reservoirs.

nodes.label: Wireless Soft Mechanoacoustic Monitoring
nodes.description: Use soft skin-coupled sensing with wireless data handling for continuous ambulatory mechanoacoustic monitoring.
nodes.function: Support untethered long-duration monitoring of body motion and sounds.
